opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members. Scheme A: undergraduate, Master's and PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on genetics research, covering travel, accommodation and registration costs for Genetics Society/SIG meetings (A), other meetings (B) and virtual conferences (C).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Enables members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project whose results would typically be suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member with caring responsibilities, regardless of age of the person they care for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Provides an award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend a Society meeting or event, used as the awardee thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: A specific Genetics Society lecture for a few hundred pounds; a Genetics Society session for up to about £1,000; as major sponsor several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorship levels £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of the meeting (not attendance).

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities running regular series of meetings, including applications to become a new Special Interest Group.
